name: In Her Embrace
source:
As forces from beyond the sky invade the Kingdom with means far beyond their comprehension, a High Priestess is faced with the impossible task–to call upon their silent god–at the price of her humanity.

[From [url=https://junicove.itch.io/in-her-embrace]itch.io[/url]]
